import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('qualtrics.db')

# Query to compute monthly average survey_progress and duration_in_seconds segmented by distribution_channel
query = """
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', start_date) as month,
    distribution_channel,
    AVG(survey_progress) as avg_survey_progress,
    AVG(duration_in_seconds) as avg_duration_seconds
FROM qualtrics__response
WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month, distribution_channel
ORDER BY month, distribution_channel;
"""

# Execute the query and load results into a DataFrame
monthly_avg_df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

# Display the results
print(monthly_avg_df.head())

# Close the connection
conn.close()
